case.summary: Case HHG-017 has been evaluated as fraud with a calibrated probability of 0.85, driven by a high-risk online channel and a device associated with a known hub-cap device family utilizing a hidden IP proxy. Although the historical alert model baseline and proxy indicators initially suggested lower risk, the customer explicitly denied making the transaction during outreach. This direct customer denial, combined with the fallback card-not-present fraud pattern, solidified the fraudulent classification of the activity. Following this verdict, the card has been blocked and a formal case has been created for further investigation.
